notes: Rebuilt for v2.0.0. Every entry carries a deep link and a verbatim snippet from that page. The v1.3.0 entries copayments-2026 and sal-briut-2026-budget cited the bare homepage https://www.health.gov.il, which no --check-sources pass could ever falsify, and their snippets were reconstructed rather than quoted. Both are removed. Three v1.3.0 URLs were hard 404s (btl.gov.il/benefits/Health_Insurance/..., btl.gov.il/About/yedion/Pages/yedion202507.aspx, kolzchut.org.il/he/ביטוח_בריאות_משלים) and two more were malformed (kolzchut Switching_Health_Plans_(Kupot_Cholim, missing its closing paren). All are removed. The three health.gov.il/Subjects/* URLs returned 202 Akamai challenges and sit on the retiring legacy tree; they are replaced by call.gov.il and gov.il/he/departments/ministry_of_health. Snippets are never de-dashed.

claims.claim: The Ministry of Health cross-kupah page restates circular 1/2025 סעיף 15.6: for a doctor, institute or outpatient visit charged once a quarter the exemption runs a FLOATING three months from the visit date, even past the end of the calendar quarter, while the ceiling for those same visits is computed on a calendar-quarter basis.
